item.title: Ototama ~Boku-tachi Girls Band Desu~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Otoko no Ko Club Z
  • 発売日: 2012-11-22
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (55 人評価)
  • 日本語名: おとたま～ぼくたちガールズバンドです～
  • 英語名: Ototama Boku-tachi Girls Band Desu

あらすじ

“We’re gonna found a band for sure, I promise!”

With this promise, the protagonist had parted with a boy from his childhood. But already 10 years later, it was time to move again. Summer passes and by late September, the protagonist had already returned back to his hometown again, due to his father’s job situation.
